policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: The issue-682 client changes add critic-rating parsing helpers and OSD/tag-pipeline coverage. The official CI client coverage gate measured 2,811/3,196 (87.954%) on this exact tree.

The advanced per-category Spoiler Guard reveals (SpoilerNextUnwatchedService with its fail-closed background boundary fill, the CategoryReveal mask in SpoilerFieldStripFilter, and seven admin config keys) settle the instrumented scope at 53,344 lines (from 53,174 on main). Four clean Release coverage runs on this exact tree observed 43,633-43,644 covered lines (81.796%-81.816%). The eleven-line envelope combines the pre-existing timing-dependent async paths documented for this branch's earlier scopes (Platform manifest reader / provider invocation / registry orchestrator, Seerr pending promoter — proven by cobertura diffs) with the new background-fill worker's disposal/no-op branches, whose coverage depends on cross-test scheduling. The floor 43,633/53,344 = 81.796% exceeds the previous required floor 43,470/53,174 = 81.750%, so the ratchet moves upward; 0.021pp is far inside the 0.15pp policy bound.
